answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops sybil farming at the jetty. Each identity posts a 20 POA deposit and must keep a distinct behavioral fingerprint no script can mirror cheaply. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit and gets it back after 30 days. Honest work stays nearly free under this velvet glove; mass fakery is expensive and slow.
